column1: # Guard regression cases. Columns: guard <TAB> fixture <TAB> command <TAB> expected
# Every spelling here was taken from alxjrvs's own session transcripts or from a
# reproduction during the 2026-07-25 audit. Cases marked REGRESSION failed on the
# pre-fix guards; they are the reason this suite exists.
# fixture:  primary (on main) | wt-a (up to date w/ main) | wt-c (stacked on feature-b) | nonrepo
# --- rebase-guard: direct push to the default branch ------------------------
# REGRESSION: `--dry-run` anywhere in the command disabled the whole guard, so a
# real push to main was ALLOWED because an unrelated commit message contained it.

column3: git commit -m "test --dry-run flag" && git push origin main
git commit -m "document --dry-run" && git push origin HEAD:main

column1: # A genuine dry run still passes — it never mutates the remote.
# --- rebase-guard: must NOT fire out of turn --------------------------------
# REGRESSION: the word "main" inside a commit message denied a push of a
# perfectly ordinary feature branch. This is the false positive alxjrvs reported.

column3: git commit -m "push to main branch when ready" && git push origin feature-a
git commit -m "merge into main later" && git push origin feature-a

column1: # Not a real push/pr-create at all.
# REGRESSION: `--base` was ignored, so a stacked PR was told to rebase onto main,
# which would flatten the stack `rebase-prs` deliberately builds.
# With no --base it really is behind origin/HEAD, so denying is correct.
# feature-b is held by another worktree in every fixture below.
# REGRESSION: only the *default* branch name was matched, so 34 of 43 measured
# real collisions (non-default branches) walked straight past the guard.
# REGRESSION: a flag between the verb and the name defeated the old regex.
# REGRESSION: a trailing pipe defeated the old terminator.
# REGRESSION: quoting defeated the old regex (documented as an accepted miss).
# main is held by the primary worktree, so this is the classic case.
# Already on it — no collision, so it must pass.
# Not a checkout of a branch at all.

column3: git commit -m "git checkout main is a bad idea"
